question: Should Telegram have a new channel-level policy that suppresses all compaction notices and `⚙️`-prefixed system text, or should this PR preserve the existing `notifyUser` and visible system-reply contracts?
rationale: The diff changes a documented opt-in delivery path and a shared visible message prefix, so maintainers need to confirm the intended product boundary before any repair or merge can be safe.

options.title: Preserve Existing Delivery Contracts
options.body: Remove the unconditional compaction-notice suppression and replace the raw glyph check with a typed or narrower classifier for only the unwanted Telegram notice class.

options.title: Approve Telegram-Wide Suppression
options.body: Treat this as a deliberate compatibility change and update docs/tests/config expectations before merge.

options.title: Pause Or Replace The PR
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if the desired suppression cannot be specified without breaking current message-delivery contracts.

recommendation.title: Preserve Existing Delivery Contracts
recommendation.body: Remove the unconditional compaction-notice suppression and replace the raw glyph check with a typed or narrower classifier for only the unwanted Telegram notice class.
